fit_reason: This is an unfinished project truck, partly disassembled, with the front clip off the chassis, an exposed engine and rust throughout. The surfaces are bare patina and surface rust rather than paint a detail could correct. The seller also writes 'Need no help to sell,' so we should not contact them.
findings: Hood, fenders and grille surround are patina and surface rust with no paint finish left to polish
Front fender and hood shown partly disassembled from the chassis, with the engine bay exposed
Seller states the truck is an incomplete project and declines help selling
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the F1 project truck with the patina on the hood and front fenders. Since it is mid-build and you mentioned you don't need help selling, we won't bother you, but if you ever want a detail once it's finished, we come to you and would be glad to give a quote.
